critical_code_review_comments: routes/twin_routes.py::twin_summary — clamps days into [1,90] but analytics_routes.calibration_card clamps days into [7,365] with days=90 default; inconsistent lower bound (twin allows days=1 which may starve replay while calibration min 7). Consider aligning min bounds.

routes/analytics_routes.py::calibration_card returns `days` echoing the raw `days` query param, NOT the clamped value passed to compute_calibration. Twin route echoes the clamped value via digital_twin.twin_summary. Minor inconsistency — a caller passing days=5000 to /analytics/calibration sees days=5000 in response although internally clamped to 365. Consider echoing the clamped value for UI transparency.

routes/analytics_routes.py::calibration_card summary uses n-weighted mean of `abs(b['gap'])` — matches per-bucket data and is correct, but effectively same as |predicted-actual| only when buckets share the same sign of gap. In real admin data buckets have mixed signs; make sure the UI headline label 'Calibration Error' communicates this is mean-absolute-error (MAE) across buckets, not |predicted-actual|=|63.4-71.7|=8.3 which differs from reported 15.

routes/twin_routes.py::twin has NO try/except around twin_summary — if intraday_candles is missing for a symbol, replay_outcome returns 'timeout' silently (verified from test_twin_replays_intercepts_and_compares). Fine for happy-path; consider surfacing 'missing_bars' count in totals for observability.
digital_twin/strategy_genetics have no unit-level input validation on user['id'] — relies on get_current_user; fine but noting for defense-in-depth.
